name: eu.muralists/directory
title: Muralists Directory
description: Search the curated directory of professional muralists and street artists in Europe.

tools.name: search_muralists
tools.description: Search a curated directory of muralists and street artists in Europe. Filter by country, city/region and style (e.g. abstract, figurative, lettering, photorealistic, geometric). Returns matching artists with portfolio highlights and profile URLs. Use this when someone wants to find, hire, or commission a mural artist.

region.description: City, province or region the artist is based in, e.g. 'Rotterdam', 'Noord-Holland', 'Berlin'. Matches city or region.

country.description: Country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ('DE') or its Dutch name ('Duitsland'). By default matches where the artist is BASED.

include_travel.description: With `country`: also return artists who will WORK there without being based there (they named the country, said 'all of Europe', or have a current or upcoming travel period there).

style.description: Style label, e.g. abstract, figurative, lettering, photorealistic, geometric.

query.description: Free text, in any language. Matched on what the murals LOOK like (subject, colour, mood: 'birds on a blue facade', 'playful schoolyard') as well as on name, tagline, bio, city and styles.

limit.description: Maximum number of artists to return (1-10).

tools.name: get_muralist_profile
tools.description: Get the full profile of a specific muralist from the Muralists directory: bio, styles, portfolio of realized works with locations, typical project types, and how to request a quote. Use after search_muralists to get details on a candidate.

id.description: The muralist's profile slug — the stable public identifier returned as `id` by search_muralists and used in the profile URL.

tools.name: search_murals
tools.description: Search individual murals (not artists) in the Muralists directory by where they are and what they look like: city, country, style, subject, colour family, outdoor or indoor wall, and the kind of place (school, office, public space, ...). Pass `brand_colours` (hex codes from a logo or a building) to rank murals by how near their own colours come; each result then carries `colour_match` from 0 to 1. Use it to find examples that fit a wall; get_muralist_profile gives the artist behind one. Every result carries the name of the artist who made it and the address of the mural's own page.

city.description: City the wall stands in, as written on the site, e.g. 'Rotterdam'.

country.description: Country the wall stands in: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ('NL') or its Dutch name.

style.description: Style slug, e.g. abstract, figurative, lettering, geometric.

subject.description: Subject slug in Dutch, e.g. dieren, mensen, natuur.

setting.description: The kind of place, in Dutch: horeca, kantoor, winkel, school, zorg, sport, woning, kinderkamer, woongebouw, bedrijfspand, openbare-ruimte.

brand_colours.description: House colours as hex codes, e.g. ['#1a4fd6', '#f2c200']. Ranks the murals by colour match and leaves out those that come nowhere near.

limit.description: Maximum number of murals to return (1-12).

tools.name: create_brief_draft
tools.description: Saves a draft brief for a mural and returns a link to it. Use it when someone has described their wall and wants to ask one or more muralists for a price. Side effect: one draft is stored on Muralists for 14 days. It does not contact any artist, create an account or a project, or commit anyone to anything. The draft becomes a project only when a person opens the returned link, logs in or makes a free account, and confirms it; they then choose whom to ask. Fields that are left out stay empty, and the result lists them in `still_open`. Each call stores a new draft.

title.description: Short name for the project, e.g. 'Mural for the canteen of school De Regenboog'.

description.description: What the person wants, in their own words and language: the idea, the theme, who it is for.

city.description: City or town the wall is in.

location.description: Where the wall is, in words, e.g. 'side wall of the car park, visible from the railway'.

wall_width_m.description: Width of the wall in metres.

wall_height_m.description: Height of the wall in metres.

wall_material.description: What the wall is made of.

wall_access.description: ground: paintable from the ground. equipment: scaffolding or a lift is needed. unknown: the person does not know.

permit_status.description: Whether a permit is needed and how far it is.

brand_colours.description: House colours the work should sit with, as hex codes.

budget_min_eur.description: Lower end of the budget in euros, if the person named one.

budget_max_eur.description: Upper end of the budget in euros, if the person named one.

timeline.description: When it should be finished, e.g. 'Q2 2027' or 'before the summer holidays'.

muralist_ids.description: Muralists the person wants to consider, as ids from search_muralists. They are put in the project's selection; none of them is contacted.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Muralists directory of muralists and street artists by free text (name, city, style). Returns matching artists with their profile URLs. Use fetch with a returned id to read the full profile.

query.description: Free-text search query, e.g. 'lettering artist Utrecht'.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of one Muralists directory profile by id, for citation. Ids come from the search tool.

id.description: The profile id (slug) returned by search.
